
  detectCodexRateLimit no longer treats credits.has_credits:false with a null
  balance as out-of-credits. It flags out-of-credits only on a meaningful
  numeric credits.balance <= 0; a null/absent balance with null
  rate_limit_reached_type falls through to the used_percent window checks →
  NOT_LIMITED. Genuine limits (numeric balance<=0, rate_limit_reached_type set,
  used_percent>=100) still classify rate_limited. Deterministic; no tmux pane
  scan added.

  Tests: corrected the bug-encoding fixture (split into a NOT-limited
  premium/null-credits case + a real balance:0 limited case) and added
  regression tests over the two attached full rollouts (intelas-65f6,
  diary-bot-1381, committed under v2/test/fixtures/codex-rollouts/) — both end
  task_complete and now classify NOT rate_limited.

  Scope held to rate-limit-detect.ts — codex stale-working (#442) and cursor
  (#471) paths untouched.
